findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 484 current-evidence audit: Emperor's Cannon is a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super used by Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain). It can generate up to eight directable Ki Blasts; some can paralyze/stun on contact, and an additional input releases the accumulated blasts together. Current dedicated skill evidence lists PQ184, while maintained repository/PQ evidence maps the acquisition to PQ183; the conflict is retained rather than silently normalized.
